notes: Variant assumption is a seated machine chest press with guided handles or a guided lever path. Pectoralis major primary, anterior deltoid secondary, and triceps brachii secondary are based on direct seated chest press/chest press machine EMG plus horizontal pressing review context. Serratus anterior support is based on direct lever-machine EMG and scapular kinematics. Rotator cuff support is explicitly an inference from close bench-press rotator cuff EMG, not direct seated machine evidence. Biceps brachii and lateral deltoid were not added as visible roles because direct evidence either did not measure them for this variant or suggested stabilizer differences without enough app-relevant contribution for this guided machine. Main unresolved uncertainty is commercial machine geometry: seat angle, handle path, neutral versus pronated grip, lever versus cable stack, and range-of-motion stops can alter emphasis.
